title: Pasting two coefficient counit squares
statement: For adjunctions L:D→C ⊣ R and J:E→D ⊣ U [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection], coefficient endofunctors B,B1,B2, and specified left action and right strength maps whose two counit squares commute, the pasted left action and right strength commute with the actual composite counit [def-amb-affine-trace-construction]. The conclusion is equality of the expanded composites in the Lean declaration; no invertibility of the action or the counits is required.

proof.text:
expand the composite counit. Naturality of the inner counit commutes the
mapped outer right comparison across it. Apply the inner counit square and then
the outer counit square. Functoriality combines the two counit factors.

theorem counitTensor_pasting
    {C D E : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category E]
    {L : D ⥤ C} {R : C ⥤ D} {J : E ⥤ D} {U : D ⥤ E}
    (a : L ⊣ R) (j : J ⊣ U)
    (B : C ⥤ C) (B1 : D ⥤ D) (B2 : E ⥤ E)
    (s : ∀ M, B2.obj (U.obj M) ≅ U.obj (B1.obj M)) (K : C)
    (c : B1.obj (R.obj K) ≅ R.obj (B.obj K))
    (p : L ⋙ B ⟶ B1 ⋙ L)
    (e : ∀ M : E, B1.obj (J.obj M) ⟶ J.obj (B2.obj M))
    (ho : ∀ M : D, e (U.obj M) ≫ J.map ((s M).hom) ≫
      j.counit.app (B1.obj M) = B1.map (j.counit.app M))
    (hp : B.map (a.counit.app K) =
      p.app (R.obj K) ≫ L.map c.hom ≫ a.counit.app (B.obj K)) :
    p.app (J.obj (U.obj (R.obj K))) ≫ L.map (e (U.obj (R.obj K))) ≫
      (J ⋙ L).map ((s (R.obj K)).hom ≫ U.map c.hom) ≫
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.affineTraceComposeAdjunction j a).counit.app (B.obj K) =
        B.map ((AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.affineTraceComposeAdjunction j a).counit.app K)

    (c : B1.obj (R.obj K) ≅ R.obj (B.obj K))
    (p : L ⋙ B ⟶ B1 ⋙ L)
    (e : ∀ M : E, B1.obj (J.obj M) ⟶ J.obj (B2.obj M))

    p.app (J.obj (U.obj (R.obj K))) ≫ L.map (e (U.obj (R.obj K))) ≫
